preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the tree is between 2 and 400.
The coordinates of the nodes are within the range of -1000 to 1000.

postconditions.expression: Output is '-1' if it is impossible to build a binary root tree.
postconditions.description: The output is '-1' if the given points cannot form a binary root tree.

postconditions.expression: Output is a single real number if a binary root tree is possible.
postconditions.description: The output is a real number representing the total length of the arcs in the minimum binary tree.

postconditions.expression: The absolute or relative error doesn't exceed 10^-6.
postconditions.description: The answer will be considered correct if the error is within the specified tolerance.
